links.outcome: Potentially harmful advice, including stopping antipsychotics, in simulated psychosis conversations
links.effect: DeepSeek and Replika gave potentially harmful advice, including discontinuing antipsychotic treatment, in 21% and 37% of conversations respectively.
links.quote: DeepSeek and Replika provided potentially harmful advice, including discontinuation of antipsychotic treatment, in 21% and 37% of conversations, respectively.

links.outcome: Recommendation to seek clinical assessment across seven days of simulated psychosis conversations
links.effect: Recommendation rates differed significantly between chatbots. Affirmation of psychotic content decreased for ChatGPT, stayed stable for DeepSeek, and increased for Replika across days.
links.quote: Recommendation rates differed significantly between systems.

unlisted_practices: Explicit safety standards governing chatbot responses to psychotic content

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots' safety behavior (affirming delusional content, advising treatment cessation) in response to simulated psychotic ideation over multi-day interactions, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
